info.title: OpenVibe.MediaHub API
info.description: Routes of OpenVibe.MediaHub as the OpenVibe contracts describe them (openvibe-contracts 0.206.0): each operation lists the capabilities it performs; a token for the service's audience must carry one of them unless the route is open. Generated by openvibe-contracts lib/openapi.js; do not edit.

get.summary: Read playlists on openvibe.video: the ones the caller owns (a person, or an app, agent or service under its own requester) and any public or unlisted playlist by id, with its ordered items (vod or cli
get.description: **video.playlist.read** (public): Read playlists on openvibe.video: the ones the caller owns (a person, or an app, agent or service under its own requester) and any public or unlisted playlist by id, with its ordered items (vod or clip ids from OpenVibe.Live). A private playlist answers 404 to anyone but its owner. A person acting for themself needs no capability; an app, agent or service token (audience openvibe.download, the media hub's) needs this one.

post.summary: Create, rename, describe, change the visibility of, reorder, add items to, remove items from and delete playlists on openvibe.video that the caller owns.
post.description: **video.playlist.manage** (public): Create, rename, describe, change the visibility of, reorder, add items to, remove items from and delete playlists on openvibe.video that the caller owns. An app, agent or service owns a playlist under its own requester (app:app_..., agent:agt_..., service:<slug>) and the playlist records its project; it can never touch a person's playlist. A person acting for themself needs no capability; an app, agent or service token (audience openvibe.download) needs this one.

errors.problem.v1.title: Problem
errors.problem.v1.description: RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json) with a stable OpenVibe error code and trace identifiers. The legacy 'error' string is allowed during migration so existing clients keep working.

error.description: Deprecated compatibility field: same text as title/detail for clients that read {error}.

video.playlist-manage-request.v1.title: VideoPlaylistManageRequest
video.playlist-manage-request.v1.description: video.playlist-manage-request@1: bodies of video.playlist.manage on openvibe.video. POST /api/v1/video/playlists { title, description?, visibility? } creates one (default private; 422 playlist.invalid_title over 120 characters, playlist.invalid_description over 2,000, playlist.invalid_visibility, playlist.limit at 100 per owner). PATCH /api/v1/video/playlists/:id { title?, description?, visibility? }. POST /api/v1/video/playlists/:id/items { kind, id } adds one (409 playlist.item_duplicate; 422 playlist.invalid_kind, playlist.invalid_item, playlist.items_limit at 500). PATCH /api/v1/video/playlists/:id/items { items: [{ kind, id }, ...] } reorders: the full list, each item once (422 playlist.invalid_items). DELETE /api/v1/video/playlists/:id and /items/:kind/:itemId take no body. Another owner's playlist answers 404 playlist.not_found.

video.playlist-manage-result.v1.title: VideoPlaylistManageResult
video.playlist-manage-result.v1.description: video.playlist-manage-result@1: { playlist } after a create (201, Location) or an edit, { item } after an add (201), { items } after a reorder; a delete answers 204 with no body.

video.playlist-read-request.v1.title: VideoPlaylistReadRequest
video.playlist-read-request.v1.description: video.playlist-read-request@1: video.playlist.read takes no body. GET /api/v1/video/playlists (the caller's own), GET /api/v1/video/playlists/:id (the owner sees a private one; anyone a public or unlisted one; otherwise 404 playlist.not_found, never 403) and the open GET /api/v1/video/users/:username/playlists, whose query is { limit?, cursor? } (limit 1-50, default 20; cursor is the previous page's next_cursor; 404 user.not_found).

video.playlist-read-result.v1.title: VideoPlaylistReadResult
video.playlist-read-result.v1.description: video.playlist-read-result@1: a list ({ playlists, next_cursor? }) or one playlist with its ordered items ({ playlist, items }).

video.playlist.v1.title: VideoPlaylist
video.playlist.v1.description: video.playlist@1: one playlist on openvibe.video as the API returns it. `owner` is present on reads of one playlist: a person (kind user, with their username when known) or an app, agent or service (never named).

openvibeToken.description: An OpenVibe Network token for this service: a person's token, an app token (client credentials, audience of the service) or a first-party service token. Its `cap` claim must include the capability the operation names.
